Valid, narrowed but still open at loop 10; accepted as a residual low, not fixed. The SME's loop-10 recheck keeps it open on byte identity: AuthController (25dff707...) is unchanged since loop 9 and was not re-probed. What is fixed (reconciler read of AuthController lines 30-40, plus the SME's loop-9 embedded-server probe): register takes a BindingResult and answers blank or missing fields and a 73-character ASCII password with 400 itself, so the anonymous caller no longer sees the ERROR-dispatch 401 for those cases, and nothing is stored. Residual stated honestly: @Size(max = 72) counts UTF-16 characters (Jakarta Validation @Size on CharSequence), while bcrypt's limit is 72 bytes, so a password of at most 72 characters but more than 72 UTF-8 bytes (for example accented letters or emoji) passes the constraint, Task 1's bcrypt encoder throws IllegalArgumentException, and the anonymous caller gets 401 with an empty body; the Registration comment ('a password over 72 characters is refused too') and the method comment ('Answer a broken registration here with 400') equate the two limits and are not true for those passwords. Malformed or non-JSON bodies also answer 401 for the same ERROR-dispatch reason. Low because no test, README step or step 6 row sends a registration and nothing is stored. The SME's recommendation (a UTF-8 byte-length check and a 72-byte comment) remains open: no further correction loop runs for lows in this delivery, so it is left for a later delivery or the technology SME.
